acceptance: PROVISIONAL; private browser overlay verified; numerical bounds pass with regional and island qualifications
limitations: Nine independent checks give RMS 46.38 m, median 45.82 m, P95 65.72 m and maximum 72.83 m; the 100 m RMS ceiling and suggested numerical companion bounds pass.
Checks span the Mira peninsula, inland lakes, lake islands and southern/eastern coast; far northeastern, western-margin and parcel interior regions remain sparse or untested.
Guyon Island has one control and no independent island check. Its complete image is retained with limited geographic validation; small offshore rocks are also untested.
Rounded cape and lake endpoints carry 12 px working source uncertainty; generalized historical boundaries and spatial correlation limit broad accuracy claims.
